_doc: Per-ticker transcript-KPI overrides for CELH. 'aliases' extend the generic transcript_kpi_library.json canonical_aliases (same form: lowercased post-normalization metric -> canonical row name). 'corrections' record audit-surfaced value fixes: each {metric, period, value|skip, note}. Corrections are applied by build_kpi_sheet.py after the matrix is built; never hand-edit digest JSONs to fix a value.
